series.label: Plot

basis.inductance: 2-D: no end-winding inductance, no 3-D factor on L
basis.fit: least squares through the origin, n in krpm

group.fit: Loss fit P = a·n + b·n² (n in krpm)

row.no_noload: no no-load duty in this configuration

tip.resistance: Model R_phase at its coil temperature, scaled to the measured temperature by (234.5 + T), x2 line-to-line in star (2/3 in delta), plus the stated lead cables. The phase board and the joints are not in the model.
tip.ldq_sum: 3-pair mean of L line-line = Ld + Lq (star). Model = the incremental Ld/Lq of the lowest-current duty.
tip.ldq_amp: 3-pair amplitude √(2/3·Σdev²) = |Lq − Ld|. The pair order on the rotor is not known, so the smaller fitted value is compared with the smaller model value.
tip.l_rotor_out: Stator without rotor: compared with a stored stator-only run when one exists.
tip.l_freq: The model is low-frequency incremental; at kHz the eddy currents in iron and magnets lower the bench reading.
tip.emf_peak: Model V_LL peak of the no-load duty, x speed ratio, x Br(test magnet T) / Br(model magnet T), x the 3-D end-effect flux factor of the configuration (Stage A; 2-D when it has no passport). Measured = Vpp / 2.
tip.emf_rms: Model V_LL rms of the no-load duty, same speed, Br and 3-D scaling.
tip.loss: Model = core (hysteresis ~n, eddy ~n², excess ~n^1.5) + solid eddy (~n²) of the no-load duty, x (Br ratio)², + bearings (SKF) + windage. The rest of the measured power is unexplained.
tip.fit: Least squares P = a·n + b·n² through the origin, n in krpm.
tip.load: The duty within 2 % speed and 3 % current. Model torque x the 3-D torque factor (measured k_T, else the flux factor). Model efficiency is the motor’s at the shaft (no inverter).
tip.eff_system: Torque·ω / (V_dc·I_dc) includes the inverter: compared only with the stored system (wall-to-shaft) efficiency of the controller record, never with the motor’s.
tip.weight: Model mass of the configuration’s parts; the bench weighs what the record names.

editor.title: Title
editor.stateTip: What was done to the motor before the test, e.g. after the acid treatment.
editor.magnetTempTip: Magnet temperature during the test when known; the EMF is scaled to it.
editor.leadsTip: The cables between the winding and the meter; a line-to-line reading runs through two of them.
editor.pairsTip: Three values in the order of the label, separated by spaces or slashes.
editor.lcr: LCR: pair mode quantity value unit freq level
editor.lcrTip: One reading per line, e.g. 1-2 parallel R 12.5 Ohm 1000 0.5
editor.insulation: Insulation: V, MΩ (> if more than)
editor.rowsTip: Paste the bench rows: 1000/140/80/28.3/40, 1500/240/120/42.4 ... or one row per line split by tabs. - = not measured.
